shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -la && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && head -50 package-lock.json

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; ls -R src __agent_eval__; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "uikit|form|login" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30

node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider Card Text Flex 2>&1 | head -80
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider Card Text Flex 2>&1 | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; rg -n -i -C 4 "required setup|styles.css|ThemeProvider|configure" README.md | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n 120,400p INDEX.md | rg -n -i "provider|textinput|password|checkbox|button|card|text\b|typography|flex|field|form|label|theming" | head -40; ls; ls components 2>/dev/null | head -100

rg -n -i "pitfall|^#|label|errorMessage|validationState|type=|autoComplete|controlProps|name|hasClear|onUpdate|^\| " components/controls/TextInput.md | head -60; echo ===PW; rg -n -i "pitfall|^#|^\| |label|autoComplete" components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -40

sed -n 1,40p components/controls/PasswordInput.md; echo ===CB; rg -n "^\| |^#|pitfall" components/Checkbox.md | head -40; echo ===BTN; rg -n -i "^\| (view|size|type|width|loading|disabled|children)|pitfall|^##" components/Button.md | head -40; echo ==CARD; rg -n -i "^\| |^##" components/Card.md | head -30

sed -n 182,199p components/Button.md; echo ==TEXT; rg -n "^\| |variant" components/Text.md | head -25; echo ==LAYOUT; rg -n -i "gap|direction|spacing=|padding|^##|<Flex|<Box" guides/layout.md | head -60; echo ==PROVIDER; rg -n -i -C 3 "<Provider|ThemeProvider" guides/theming.md | head -50

sed -n 1,20p guides/theming.md; sed -n 60,72p guides/theming.md; rg -n -C 3 "lang" guides/i18n.md | head -30; echo ==TRAPS; rg -n "^#" /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 15,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 150,175p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 306,342p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n "variant|header|subheader|display" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md | head -20
rm -rf dist && echo "dist/" >> .gitignore && git status --short && git diff package.json
